title: fix(plugin-dashboard,plugin-designer): the 22 slot-entry and chart-producer reads compile without `BaseSchema`'s index signature (objectui#11598)
body:
Fixes #11598

Clause-②: no

The plugin-dashboard and plugin-designer half that the removal of `BaseSchema`'s index signature (objectui#8347) needs first. The 22 source reads that compiled only through that signature now compile without it, and the signature is still present. Two commits, one per class, so they read apart: `921e56cc` (N1) and `d6da79f6` (N2). The parent objectui#8347 stays open; this PR only clears its `Blocked-by:`.

## N1: the `chart` producers' render keys (seat ruling B)

- New `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/chartRenderHandoff.ts` declares `DashboardChartRenderSchema`: `ChartSchema` plus `colors?: string[]` and `isAnimationActive?: boolean`. Its header follows plugin-timeline's `renderHandoff.ts` (the objectui#6356 ruling, Q1 = A). It is not exported from the package index (the built `dist/index.d.ts` names it 0 times) and is not added to `@object-ui/types`.
- `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` build the static-data `chart` node as a const annotated with the hand-off. That annotation excess-checks the literal against it. The node is then returned to `SchemaRenderer` with no cast. Nothing drawn changes.
- **H3 holds; the consumer side needs nothing.** `ChartRenderer` (`packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.tsx`) declares both keys on its own props type (`ChartRendererProps.schema`: `colors?: string[]`, `isAnimationActive?: boolean`) and reads `schema.colors` and `schema.isAnimationActive` with no cast. The registered `chart` component receives the node as `schema`, typed by that props type, not by `ChartSchema`. The new test pins the hand-off's two key types as assignable to `React.ComponentProps` of `ChartRenderer`'s `schema`.

## N2: widget keys read off the slot entry (seat ruling A, premised)

- **Premise checked first, and it holds** (evidence below): no authored document carries a widget-arm key on a `metric-card` entry.
- Both surfaces now decide the slot-component passthrough before reading any widget key: `if (isSlotComponentEntry(widget)) return toDashboardNodeType({ ...widget })`. Below that line `widget` is the widget arm, so `options`, `chartConfig`, `filter`, `compareTo`, `searchable` and `pagination` are read off the arm that declares them.
- The either-arm `dataset` fork is gone. `DashboardRenderer` reads `dataset` off `widgetArm` (the entry narrowed by `isSlotComponentEntry`). `DashboardGridLayout`'s twin fork was a cast, `(widget as { dataset?: unknown })`. The P1 census could not see a cast, so this is a 23rd read; it now narrows the same way.
- `entryComponent` reads `component` on the widget arm only. Its cross-arm read is gone.
- `DashboardWithConfig` seeds the config panel's `dataset`, `dimensions`, `values` and `colorVariant` from the widget arm. Before, the first three were read through `as any`.
- `DashboardEditor` (plugin-designer) narrows with a local twin of the guard, because it cannot import plugin-dashboard (the same reason its `measureRefusal` is a twin). Both read the one closed list, `DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES`. The Color Variant select is offered for a widget only (H2, below).
- Also narrowed: the filter-bar scoping in `DashboardRenderer` (`buildWidgetScopedFilter` reads `filterBindings` through a `Pick`), and the `subCaption` read at both dataset forks.
- **What changes at runtime.** Only a `metric-card` entry that carries a widget key changes. The strict face refuses such an entry and the tolerant face accepts it (pinned). That card now draws itself. Before, it drew one of three other things: the dataset tile (on both surfaces), its own keys with `options` spread over them, or the node in its `component` envelope. Every document the strict face accepts draws as before.

## Measurements

### H1: the 22 sites, before and after

The instrument: the four tsc programs (`tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json` of each package), one-off, trap-restored. It deletes the docblock and signature lines of `BaseSchema` in `packages/types/src/base.ts` and rebuilds `@object-ui/types`; the dist keeps one signature, `ComponentRendererProps`'. Restore is proven by the blob hash equal to HEAD's and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

H1 holds: `origin/main` is still the census's `94985a9`, and BASE reproduces the census exactly. No site was added or removed.

Program totals with the signature removed, BASE then HEAD:

- plugin-dashboard src: 18, then 0.
- plugin-dashboard test: 24, then 6.
- plugin-designer src: 4, then 0.
- plugin-designer test: 4, then 0.

The 6 left are objectui#8347's adjudicated probe flips (`bogusKey` ×2, `zzUndeclared7353` ×4), the same 6 at BASE. With the signature present, all four programs exit 0 at both commits.

**The N1 hand-off really checks the literal.** In a one-off probe with the signature removed, a planted `bogusProbeKey11598` on each `chart` literal fails with TS2353 "does not exist in type 'DashboardChartRenderSchema'", in `DashboardGridLayout` and in `DashboardRenderer`. The probe was trap-restored and hash-verified.

### N2 premise census (at BASE)

- **Population**: `git grep -l -F metric-card 94985a92 -- .`, 45 files. Each file is read with `git show` at the same commit, so the file list and the contents come from the same source.
- **Detector**: every object literal whose `type` is `'metric-card'`, found two ways. AST: the TypeScript compiler over TS, TSX and JSON. SCAN: the balanced brace region around each occurrence, which covers md and mdx. Each literal's keys are compared with the widget-arm-only key set (`dataset`, `options`, `chartConfig`, `filter`, `component`, `colorVariant`, `values`, `dimensions`, `compareTo`, `searchable`, `pagination`, `filterBindings` and the rest of the spec row).
- **Result**: 51 AST and 88 SCAN literals. **2 carry a widget-arm key**, both in `packages/types/src/__tests__/metric-card-needs-value-11483.test.ts`. They are refusal probes: a card with `dataset` and `values`, and a card with `options`, each with no `value` and refused on every face. They are not authored documents.
- **Per corpus, 0 hits**:
  - `content/docs/**`: 2 files, 9 literals.
  - `examples/**`: 3 schema-catalog dashboards, 11 literals.
  - Package READMEs: 2 files, 16 literals.
  - `skills/**`: no file in the population.
  - app-shell seeds and presets: none. app-shell's only file in the population is a test that uses the `plugin-dashboard:metric-card` node key.
- **Lit controls**:
  - Planted: an md file with a fenced dashboard whose card carries `dataset`, and a TS file whose card carries `options` and `component`. Both are flagged.
  - Real corpus: the same detector pointed at `type: 'bar'` sees the known widget-arm `dataset` entry in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` (`{ "id": "w1", "type": "bar", "dataset": "invoices", … }`) and the schema catalog's `filtered-dashboard-dataset-widgets.json` entry.

### The two-way `dataset` pin, and reverse validation

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/slotEntryWidgetArmReads-11598.test.tsx` tests on both surfaces. It identifies `DatasetWidget` by its `dataset-loading` skeleton under a query that never settles.

- A widget-arm entry with `dataset` draws `DatasetWidget`, and the query is called with `{ dimensions: ['status'], measures: ['count'] }`.
- A `metric-card` carrying `dataset` does not reach it: the card's `$24k` is drawn, no skeleton appears, and no query is sent.
- The CONTROL is a strict-valid card, which draws as before.
- The file also pins the `options` and `component` reads, `entryComponent`, and the face verdicts: each moved card is strict-refused at `widgets.0` and tolerant-accepted.

The designer test is `packages/plugin-designer/src/__tests__/DashboardEditor.slotComponentArm-11598.test.tsx`.

**Reverse validation, run from the committed state.** The five N2 source files were put back to their bytes at `921e56cc`. On disk, the `N2 A` markers went from 10 to 0 and the either-arm comment came back. With the new pins unchanged, the run was `Tests 8 failed | 10 passed (18)`:

- every card case failed on both surfaces: `dataset-loading` rendered in the card's place, `OPTIONS-FIGURE` drawn, and the envelope drawn;
- the `entryComponent` unit failed;
- the designer `metric-card` case failed;
- the positives, controls and face checks stayed green.

The direction was red, as expected. The restore is proven by 5 blob hashes equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` at 0 bytes. My first attempt stopped before running any test: its marker count was wrong, because N1 had already put the issue number into two of the files. It was re-run with the `N2 A` marker.

### H2: `DashboardEditor`

- **`values` and `dimensions`** are read by `measureRefusal`, the door probe behind the type picker. For a strict-valid `metric-card` they were already absent, so the probe is unchanged and nothing is visible.
- **`colorVariant`** is the Color Variant select. Here the seat's "invisible" expectation does not hold. The select was offered for every `metric-card` entry, and a pick wrote `colorVariant` onto the card. The strict face refuses that key on the card, and `MetricCard` has no such prop, so the value is not drawn (app-shell's `widget-dom-leak-sweep` test notes it lands as a `colorvariant` DOM attribute). After this PR, a `metric-card` entry is not offered the select. Title, width and height stay, and a widget is offered the select as before. So one control is gone for strict-valid cards, and its only effect was storing a key that publish refuses.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface, declared.** This PR also rewrites one paragraph in `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and the same paragraph in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`. Both said "a `dataset` makes the dashboard draw its dataset tile in the card's place", which this change makes false (AGENTS.md #2). It also repairs four cross-file line citations inside the `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` comments it touched, by content (AGENTS.md #11).
- **Prose made false in `packages/types`, not edited, because the claim excludes `packages/types`.** Each is a present-tense account of the either-arm draw:
  - `complex.ts`, in the `DASHBOARD_COMPONENT_WIDGET_TYPES` docblock: "a `dataset` draws `DatasetWidget` in the card's place by a rule that ignores the `type`";
  - `zod/complex.zod.ts`, the same sentence, plus "The `options` bag is spread onto the node as literal props";
  - `__tests__/metric-card-needs-value-11483.test.ts`, in its header and two inline comments.

  The first two ship in `@object-ui/types`' dist JSDoc. Proposed carrier: the PR that executes objectui#8347, which already edits complex.ts's `widgets` notes. Or the seat may direct otherwise (see the report).
- Observation, not reproduced: `DashboardEditor`'s type picker still offers widget types for a `metric-card` entry. A pick would write a widget `type` onto the card's keys.
- `isLegacyRetiredWidget` still reads `dataset`, `data`, `options` and `object` through its own named shape. After the reorder, it only ever receives widget-arm entries on both surfaces.
